highlights.title: Grand Theft Auto VI is a different kind of GTA — so it needed a different kind of ending
highlights.summary: In most Grand Theft Auto games, and most open-world games for that matter, the world is left open for you to explore once the credits roll. It could be Los Santos or a twisted take on Manhattan, but the idea is that the main story is just one part of the experience.
body: GTA VI producer Rob Nelson explains Rockstar’s approach to letting players explore Vice City after the main story.

“In this one it didn’t make sense,” Rob Nelson, producer on GTA VI and co-studio head at developer Rockstar North, told me ahead of the game’s launch. “Their story needed to end and have some kind of conclusion.”
This story contains light spoilers for the ending of Grand Theft Auto VI, along with a key plot point from chapter 1.

To be clear, you can still play GTA VI after the main storyline wraps up. But in order for that to happen, you have to zip back in time to a moment before a pivotal decision — I won’t spoil it for you — that alters the lives of main characters Jason and Lucia, along with their young son Tomás, who they’re attempting to get custody of. Nelson says the team tried “all sorts of things” but soon realized that “in no way did it make sense” to have the game end like a traditional GTA experience.
points: In most Grand Theft Auto games, and most open-world games for that matter, the world is left open for you to explore once the credits roll.
It could be Los Santos or a twisted take on Manhattan, but the idea is that the main story is just one part of the experience.
“Their story needed to end and have some kind of conclusion.”

highlights.title: A New Breed of Chip Runs AI Models Using Waves of Light
highlights.summary: German company Q.ANT is trying to cut the amount of energy required to run AI models by using light to perform the toughest calculations.
body: As artificial intelligence becomes an unavoidable part of everyday life and models become ever more sophisticated, the cost of the energy required to run the technology is ballooning.

To rein in runaway costs, AI labs and cloud providers are trying to build new data centers in places with cheap and plentiful renewable energy— like Scandinavia. But logistical challenges, a scarcity of key components, and a swell of anti-data center protests are getting in the way.

An expanding field of hardware startups, among them German company Q.ANT, is coming at the problem from a different direction: by developing a new breed of chip— photonic processors —meant to minimize the amount of energy that AI models consume.

Whereas regular GPUs transmit and process data by shuffling electrons around, photonic processors use waves of light. Because light doesn’t generate heat as it travels and allows more data to be processed simultaneously, photonic processors supposedly consume less energy and require minimal cooling—one of the largest sources of cost for data centers.

highlights.title: At last, I've finally played Faraway, an enigma I've been waiting 16 years to see
highlights.summary: For 16 years I've been watching the skies. It was 16 years ago, back in the first giddy rush of smartphone gaming, that I saw a 30-second trailer for a game set in space. It was a game about a comet, hurtling through the unknown.
body: Faraway is one of those wonderfully cludged together childhood words, like "nonesuch". Where is the edge of the galaxy? Oh, it's faraway. Where is the edge of the universe? Oh, there's nonesuch thing.

Okay, Faraway came with one other bit of info I could cling to at the time. It was being made by Steph Thirion, a musician and designer and, I sensed, many other things too. At the time Faraway was announced I'd just played his game Eliss, which was an early smartphone hit. In the absence of any more information on Faraway itself, I had to make do with that. Maybe Faraway would be a bit like Eliss?

Eliss itself, though? Oh, boy. This thing is beautiful, frantic, strange, compelling and indescribable. And think what that means, just for a second, for something to be both compelling and indescribable. I am driven to do these things, but I don't really know what these things are. I'm prodding little bits of colour around, maybe planets, maybe molecules? I am combining them, gathering them, turning them into something greater together than they are by themselves?
points: It was 16 years ago, back in the first giddy rush of smartphone gaming, that I saw a 30-second trailer for a game set in space.

highlights.title: Russell: Hamilton ruthless like Verstappen but has grace and values
highlights.summary: George Russell says Lewis Hamilton is an equally "ruthless competitor" to Max Verstappen but that his former team-mate has "incredible values, grace and dignity".
body: Russell and Verstappen's rivalry reignited last weekend at the Las Vegas Grand Prix following a minor collision between the pair in practice, after which the Mercedes driver publicly criticised his Red Bull rival's conduct.

Verstappen won a thrilling race in Las Vegas that saw Russell challenge him for the lead for long periods before crashing and finishing ninth, and afterwards the four-time world champion said the Brit is "so far below my level" before adding that it was "fantastic" seeing him make an error.

Speaking exclusively to Martin Brundle during an interview that will air during Sky Sports F1's live coverage of the Qatar Grand Prix on Sunday, Russell said he found Verstappen's verbal attack on him "amusing", before drawing a comparison between the Dutchman and seven-time world champion Hamilton.
"He [Verstappen] is a ruthless competitor and I massively respect that, but there's also Lewis Hamilton, who I've spent three years team-mates with and watched my whole life," Russell said.

highlights.title: Intel faced a choice: Give Trump 10% or face the consequences
highlights.summary: The message from the Trump administration to one of the world’s leading semiconductor companies was clear: Give the US government a chunk of your company. Right now. Or else.
body: Do not make the “mistake of thinking that this is a negotiation,” Commerce Department lawyer David Shapiro told the chief financial officer of the Intel Corporation in August 2025, according to internal notes from a company call contained in a federal lawsuit. “The President is expecting to announce a deal on these terms on Friday.”

Shapiro acknowledged that “the Board could choose not to accept the offer,” according to a summary of his remarks prepared for Intel’s directors. But the Trump administration official “noted that rejection will have consequences that [Shapiro] cannot predict.”

Days later, the board gave the administration what it wanted. “It is my Great Honor to report that the United States of America now fully owns and controls 10% of INTEL,” Donald Trump posted to his social platform. “The United States paid nothing for these Shares, and the Shares are now valued at approximately $11 Billion Dollars. This is a great Deal for America.”

President Trump was similarly jubilant on Monday, announcing that he had “ convinced ” Nvidia’s board of directors to rehire chief executive Jensen Huang. The proclamation was a shock. But it wasn’t entirely without precedent.

highlights.title: Someone Is Making One of Baldur's Gate 3's Most Popular Villains Romanceable
highlights.summary: Baldur's Gate 3 has no shortage of romances and romantic encounters, but not everyone in Faerûn is up for a smooch. When developer Larian was still rolling out updates, fans would often ask for more romances to be added, whether it be for Jaheira or Rolan, but it was never meant to be.
body: One of the most popular requests was actually for one of Baldur's Gate 3's main villains, Gortash. Larian was very much aware of this, and actually addressed these fans in the patch notes in 2024.
"Listen, he’s a complicated guy who’s busy contemplating the minutia of death cult office politics," Larian said at the time. "Babygurl doesn’t have time to kiss."

But now, a fan is stepping up, adding the Gortash romance that so many were asking for. TikTok user Equipouet has shared some clips from the mod, which is still a work in progress. It shows the player character being invited to spend time with Gortash, played by Lucius Malfoy actor Jason Isaacs, after his coronation in Act 3, all with new dialogue and animations.

We're told that we'll be able to make our own choices when we meet Gortash, specifically whether we want to "charm him, keep him guessing, or walk away." So, if you really hate Gortash, you could also use the mod to let him down.

highlights.title: Avengers: Doomsday has brought with it more ‘Marvel homework’ than ever. That’s just as it should be
highlights.summary: Working out where returning hero Steve Rogers has been is only one of the multiversal puzzles fans must now get their heads around – which is catnip for the connoisseurs.
body: The cinema release of Avengers: Doomsday is now roughly three weeks away and, judging by the final trailer, we’re living in the one timeline where every loose end Marvel has left dangling for years is now worth tugging on. Even the ones we thought the studio had tied up rather nicely. Ever since it became apparent that Chris Evans’ Steve Rogers would be returning in the new film, along with next year’s sequel Avengers: Secret Wars, fans have been asking themselves: where exactly has he been all this time? Now, thanks to the latest footage, we’re beginning to get an idea, and we might also be starting to pick up clues as to why Doctor Doom would take an interest in his new postcode.

One of the most startling aspects of the new trailer is the arrival of the Fantastic Four, led by Pedro Pascal’s Reed Richards, on Rogers’ front lawn. We’ve known since the finale of Avengers: Endgame that Steve used Tony Stark’s newly discovered time-travelling tech to go back to the 1940s and live out his life with Peggy Carter during the events of that film – but until recently it seemed most likely that happened in good old Earth-616, the main Marvel Cinematic Universe continuity.

highlights.title: Taking Trainium3 to the Track: Generating Videos with LTX-2.5
highlights.summary: We’re on a journey to advance and democratize artificial intelligence through open source and open science.
body: Thanks to our partnership with AWS, we were lucky enough to get access to a Trainium3 machine ( trn3.48xlarge, 64 NeuronCores) for a month. We spent most of the month testing Hugging Face models on it, and getting more of them to work.
With five days left, I allowed myself a little fun. When you have a Ferrari, every now and then you want to take it out on the track. So I asked myself: what if I tried to generate videos?

I picked LTX-2.5 from Lightricks, which generates video and sound together. By the end, once the models were loaded, a 10-second clip with sound took 22 to 23 s to generate, on half of the machine. Here is the result.

I had two goals. The first was to see how easy it is to generate videos with diffusers on Trainium3. Not the simple clips from the examples: I wanted to make short films from a script, closer to a real use case, like drafting a movie. The second was performance. I wanted to get close to what you get with CUDA, or with LTX's own API.
points: We’re on a journey to advance and democratize artificial intelligence through open source and open science.
Thanks to our partnership with AWS, we were lucky enough to get access to a Trainium3 machine ( trn3.48xlarge, 64 NeuronCores) for a month.
I picked LTX-2.5 from Lightricks, which generates video and sound together.
The first was to see how easy it is to generate videos with diffusers on Trainium3.

highlights.title: Are you a warlock tired of being summon-kicked in World of Warcraft: Forever? There's now a mod to fight back with
highlights.summary: Being recruited to a World of Warcraft party as a warlock, only to be swiftly kicked again after using your powers to magically summon the party members together in the same place, may soon become a thing of the past. All thanks to a mod made by one especially peeved warlock.
body: The practice of exploiting warlocks in this way is called summon-kicking, and aside from the in-game reporting feature, there is little recourse to admonish such behavior.
Enter Summoners Union, the add-on mod, which grants the ability to flag and track players who summon-kick thereby building a collective case against them.

The mod was showcased on the World of Warcraft: Forever Reddit by user 274Moons, highlighting its ability to flag players after they boot you from a party, but also that it warns you if anyone in the party has a record of summon-kicking. It can also be combined with an in-game chat channel where warlock comrades can pull together and discuss and ultimately maybe fend off this nasty behavior.

"I play a lock and got tired of the usual 'hey can you summon?', ten minutes at the stone, last person comes through, *You have been removed from the group.*," 274Moons wrote. "So I made an addon about it. It's called The Summoners Union."

body: Elite cooking while talking like a Bren gun is a skill she’s honed, first in cookery demos “talking to a plastic bag and a stray dog, and you’d be lucky if someone came over to shelter from the rain”; then on Saturday Kitchen – a trial by fire: “Everything is easy after that. I could do any cookery programme now. I even tried to persuade them to do the MasterChef final live.”

Haugh grew up in Tallaght, a working-class suburb of Dublin, the youngest of four, her dad an engineer, her mother an incredible home cook who made everything from scratch, including things nobody ever makes, like cereal. “She taught us how to cook as a life skill,” says Haugh. “It was about nutrition and economy. Dad was the foodie.”

highlights.title: Nvidia hits pause on chip shipments to Southeast Asia
highlights.summary: Nvidia has told manufacturing partners to pause server shipments to Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand and Indonesia as the U.S. tightens its push to keep AI chips out of China.
body: Nvidia is under pressure to do things differently, and a new WSJ report shows how far that’s going.

According to the Journal, Nvidia has told manufacturing partners, including Dell and Super Micro, to hit pause on server shipments to Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand, and Indonesia for an unspecified period as it assesses whether its regional partners are meeting U.S. export requirements.

As for why those countries, Chinese companies have been tapping Nvidia chips remotely from data centers there, a loophole the US Commerce Department closed — reportedly grudgingly — earlier this month. The Journal notes that the think tank Institute for Progress estimates remote data centers like these supply about 24% of China’s AI computing power.

highlights.title: Meta Refused to Share Muse for Testing, UK Financial Watchdog Complains
highlights.summary: The FCA warned against “another force of attack” from agents after the company declined a request to work on joint testing ahead of rolling out its personal agent in the UK on Tuesday.
body: Meta declined a suggestion from the UK’s financial regulator last week that they joint-test Muse using their sandbox, according to the watchdog’s head of innovation Colin Payne. It comes as regulators across the UK, including the competition and data watchdogs, warned Meta it needs to ensure its AI products comply with UK consumer protection laws.

“It’s another force of attack, agents hitting the streets, most of them coming from the US,” Payne, of the Financial Conduct Authority (FCA), said Tuesday in a panel hosted by AI firm Whitespace. “We’ve got a number of entrants into the market. We want to see what they’re going to be doing in the market. I think it’s just reasonable,” he later explained to WIRED. Payne told WIRED the FCA had been hoping the organizations could work together to investigate what interactions might look like between the tool, marketed as a personal assistant, and a normal customer.
His organization has been experimenting with other firms as many, including Amazon, roll out AI shopping assistants, and other agentic tools in the UK.

highlights.summary: Most Commanders in Magic: The Gathering have to show up on the battlefield before they can do anything. But Edgar Markov can make you the most dangerous player at the table while he’s still sitting in the Command Zone.
body: Nine years after his debut in Commander 2017, Edgar ranks second on EDHREC, with more than 52,000 decks tracked over the past two years. Given his Eminence ability, which Wizards itself has admitted was a mistake, it's easy to see why.

While most people spend Black Friday buying presents for the holidays, we at Polygon celebrate all things vampire and vampire-adjacent with Fangsgiving. So let’s talk about the guy who sired an entire plane’s worth of vampires and then became one of Magic: The Gathering’s most lethal (and controversial) Commanders.

Magic actually introduced Edgar’s grandson first. Sorin Markov debuted as a mono-black vampire planeswalker in 2009’s Zendikar, where he had unfinished business with the Eldrazi he’d helped imprison thousands of years prior. Two years after that, Innistrad took players to Sorin's home plane. In Wizards of the Coast’s A Planeswalker’s Guide to Innistrad, a description of a hilltop estate in Stensia casually identifies its owner as Edgar Markov, Sorin’s grandfather. The guide also connects Edgar to the ritual that gave rise to Innistrad’s original 12 vampire bloodlines.

highlights.title: Pickled Celery Gibson
highlights.summary: A Gibson usually substitutes a cocktail onion for the olive. This version features easy homemade pickled celery and has the same clean, briny qualities as the classic.
body: From Victorian celery vases to midcentury relish trays, celery has been part of hosting parties in the United States for many generations. At gatherings hosted by my grandma Dorothy in western New York in the ’90s, I remember big stalks of celery resting in pitchers of salt water in the middle of every table, acting as both a palate-cleansing snack and a centerpiece. Similarly, this recipe for pickled celery can function as a garnish (consider skewering it onto a cocktail pick with a cornichon and a cherry tomato for a Bloody Mary), part of a canapé, or just as a snack on its own.

In a small saucepan over low heat, combine ½ cup [120 ml] distilled vinegar, 1 tsp. kosher salt, 1 tsp. sugar, 2 garlic cloves, 1 tsp. black peppercorns, 1 clove, and ¼ tsp. coriander seeds with ½ cup [120 ml] water. Cook for about 5 minutes, until the sugar and salt are dissolved. Place 4 celery stalks (about 200 g), cut into 1½" [4 cm] lengths, in a heatproof bowl, and pour the hot brine over it. Allow the mixture to cool to room temperature, then transfer it to an airtight container. Refrigerate at least overnight before using, and store, refrigerated, for up to 1 week.

videos.summary: Enjoy all goals and match highlights from Morocco vs Spain in Group H of the FIFA U-17 World Cup Qatar 2026. Spain secured a 2-0 group stage win at Aspire Zone in Doha as Ebrima Tunkara struck in the first half and Guillermo Trujillano doubled the lead after the break.

Follow the FIFA World Cup:
points: Enjoy all goals and match highlights from Morocco vs Spain in Group H of the FIFA U-17 World Cup Qatar 2026.
Spain secured a 2-0 group stage win at Aspire Zone in Doha as Ebrima Tunkara struck in the first half and Guillermo Trujillano doubled the lead after the break.
Spain top Group H with a perfect nine points, while Morocco still finish second on goal difference to reach the Round of 32. #Morocco #Spain #u17wc
